extraction.title: Notification Rule Processing Engine
extraction.head: notification-rule-enhancements

greptile.text: Paraphrase: The PR refactors Grafana's notification rule engine from a dual Prometheus plus Ruler API approach to a single-source architecture, cutting API calls. It adds GrafanaPromRuleDTO with provenance tracking and an isProvisionedPromRule helper. GrafanaRuleLoader is removed and folded into GrafanaGroupLoader, and a new GrafanaRuleListItem renders alerting, recording and unknown rule types. Confidence score of 2/5, warns of missing function imports, possible runtime errors and incomplete federated rule support.
Logic: GrafanaRuleListItem is missing a key prop for the list item; it should be key={key} to prevent React rendering issues. (Suggests adding key={key}.)
Style: The '// duplicate' comment on the useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable call in useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities should be removed. (Suggests removing that comment.)
Style: The check on rule.type in promAlertingRule is redundant, since prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) already confirms rule.type is PromRuleType.Alerting.
Style: useGrafanaPromRuleAbility is mocked here but not used in this test, so the unused mock should be removed to avoid confusion.
Style: The delete menu item selector is defined but never used in tests; add a delete action test or remove the selector.
Notice that the free trial has ended and that code reviews continue only if a payment method is added.
